name: nuelink
label: Nuelink
description: Social media scheduling: create, schedule, edit and track posts across your Nuelink brands and collections.

token.label: Automation Token (legacy)
token.description:
Works only with **Create Post**, which adds posts to the one collection chosen when the token was made. For every other action, add an **API Key** connection instead.

To get an automation token:
1. Sign in to Nuelink and open **Automations**.
2. Create a new automation for **Activepieces** and pick the collection the posts should go to.
3. Copy the token Nuelink shows and paste it here.

createPost.label: Create Post
createPost.description: Adds a post to the collection linked to your Nuelink automation token. Needs an Automation Token connection; with an API key, use Create Post in Collection.

media.label: Media
media.description: Public URL of one image or video. Nuelink downloads it, so it must open without a login.

title.label: Title
title.description: Enter a title to use for your Reels, videos and/or Pinterest posts.

altText.label: Alt Text
altText.description: Enter an alt text for your image or video.

shareToFeed.label: Share Instagram Reel to Feed
shareToFeed.description: Share your Instagram Reel to your feed as well.

postAsShort.label: Treat videos as short-form vertical videos
postAsShort.description: We will treat the videos imported as short-form vertical videos (Reels, Shorts, Tiktoks etc...).
